SHOP_DESC_CHRISTMAS_ITEM_0: Twisted vines of moss and fungi from Greenpath, adorned with delicate crystal berries. A symbol of resilience and unity, even in the harshest winters. Its soft glow promises to illuminate any dark corner.
SHOP_DESC_CHRISTMAS_ITEM_1: Carefully wrapped treasures of unknown content. A gift for the curious and kind-hearted, overflowing with the mystery and joy of the season. Who knows what wonders might hide inside?
SHOP_DESC_CHRISTMAS_ITEM_2: Simple pillars of wax with flames flickering like soft whispers. Their steady glow calms the restless soul and banishes the shadows. A reminder of tranquility amid the gloom.
SHOP_DESC_CHRISTMAS_ITEM_3: A large, ancient sapling covered in luminous moss and decorated with small ornaments. An emblem of everlasting hope, whose presence fills the air with nostalgic warmth. Bound to cheer up any bug.
SHOP_DESC_CHRISTMAS_ITEM_4: Strands of delicate luminescence, crafted from hollowed lumafly shells. Their gentle hum provides a cozy glow, weaving light through the most winding paths.
SLY_SHOP_INTRO: Ahhh, little traveler! It is you! The tiny hero I've heard so much about, leaping from shadow into light. What joy!Heh heh! I've prepared my wares for the festive season, a custom from my homeland: when the night grows long, we brighten the home and give a gift to those we cherish. You've braved many deep and dismal places, haven't you? Perhaps a bit of shine will warm up that quiet shell of yours, eh?
SLY_NOSTOCK_1: My word, you've bought me out entirely! Not a single ornament or jingle bell left to spare. Such enthusiasm warms my little heart, dear traveler.For now, take your treasures and spread a little cheer, won't you? The world could always use a touch of light. Farewell, my festive friend!
SLY_NOSTOCK_2: My word, you've bought me out entirely! Not a single ornament or jingle bell left to spare. Such enthusiasm warms my little heart, dear traveler.For now, take your treasures and spread a little cheer, won't you? The world could always use a touch of light. Farewell, my festive friend!
MERRY_DIALOG_1: Blessings be upon you, little one. That is how we bid farewell in my homeland when the season arrives. You have a keen eye for joy. Travel safely, and may your path be bright!
MERRY_DIALOG_2: I have gifts for those festive at heart! In my homeland, as the nights grow long, we hang greenery, light candles, and give gifts expecting nothing in return. We call this custom Christmas. Come, take a look.
MERRY_DIALOG_3: Still here? No rush, no rush... In my homeland, this holiday lasts until the final candle burns out. After all, the season is meant for sharing!
XMAS_ELDERBUG_INTRO: An outsider has set up a shop in Dirtmouth, little traveler. She says she brings a tradition from her home called 'Christmas'. She brought sacks filled with shiny objects I've never seen in Hallownest... I don't quite understand why anyone would decorate an almost deserted town, but the surface wind feels a little lighter today.
XMAS_ELDERBUG_DECOR_0: Do you see those green branches hanging on the doors? The outsider says they are put up to remind the cold that life still endures. What an unusual custom... and yet, it brings a certain comfort to these old timbers.
XMAS_ELDERBUG_DECOR_1: Wrapped packages, carefully placed with no owner in sight. She explained to me that they are given out of pure affection... giving something without expecting anything in return. Ah... I struggle to remember the last time someone made such a gesture in these lands.
XMAS_ELDERBUG_DECOR_2: In the glory years, every home in Dirtmouth kept its own flame lit. They went out one by one without anyone counting them... Today I watch these candles and find myself... counting their tiny flames once again.
XMAS_ELDERBUG_DECOR_3: A grand tree now stands in the center of the town square, adorned with tiny sparkles. I don't know its true purpose... And yet, I've spent hours gazing at it in silence. It has been a long time since I felt such a serene peace.
XMAS_ELDERBUG_DECOR_4: Those small lights flicker with the same warmth as the kingdom's old lanterns in the days of my youth... Tell me... do you see their glow as well, or is it just nostalgia clouding my eyes?
XMAS_ELDERBUG_ALL: You know? I asked the outsider if these lights last forever. She answered that the holiday ends, but the warmth stays with those who remember it. Looking at Dirtmouth today... for the first time in eons, I don't feel like this town is simply waiting to fade away. Perhaps it is worth keeping these decorations up a little longer.
XMAS_BRETTA_INTRO: A lady from distant lands came to visit me... She brought a gentle smile and asked if I had any lights burning. She said that in her home, no one should spend these days in the dark. I thought it was so sweet... Spending so much time alone in the dark corner isn't easy for anyone.
XMAS_BRETTA_DECOR_0: Look at those decorations hanging on the houses... Those garlands make it seem as if the doors were dressing up to welcome a very special visitor.
XMAS_BRETTA_DECOR_1: The stranger told me that back home they wrap presents for the people they cherish... I wonder if a certain traveler will think of me when seeing something pretty... Ah... pay me no mind, just my silly rambling...
XMAS_BRETTA_DECOR_2: They placed candles in the windows to guide travelers back home... I keep one burning in mine every night, in hopes that my savior will return.
XMAS_BRETTA_DECOR_3: That big tree in the center of town, filled with sparkles... It looks straight out of one of those stories about dances and dashing knights.
XMAS_BRETTA_DECOR_4: Those tiny hanging lights look like little stars caught right in the middle of town... Ah, it's all so romantic...
XMAS_BRETTA_ALL: All of Dirtmouth is filled with lights... Not long ago I was alone and forgotten in that cave, and now everything looks so lovely. The outsider told me these days are meant for being close to those you cherish... I wonder if one day my knight will stay to celebrate with me.
XMAS_SLY_INTRO: A competitor! I went to inspect her wares and... do you know what she did? She offered me a sweet treat without asking for a single Geo in return! Madness!... It was exquisite, I must admit. I had to go back for another, purely for commercial inspection... She says in her homeland they give gifts to their neighbors. A ruinous custom for any proper business!
XMAS_SLY_DECOR_0: Hanging branches over doorways... I see no mercantile benefit in giving away foliage, though I must admit it draws the eyes of passersby toward nearby shops.
XMAS_SLY_DECOR_1: Wrapped boxes given away for free? A disastrous strategy! Although... I've noticed the locals coming into my shop to buy containers to fill them with. Perhaps that outsider isn't so naive after all...
XMAS_SLY_DECOR_2: Candles lit in every window... If someone neglects a flame and a mishap occurs, they'll need to buy replacements. I shall have to increase my inventory of supplies...
XMAS_SLY_DECOR_3: That huge tree in the square attracts more foot traffic than my best discounts. A colossal display gathering everyone on the surface... I admit, I admire her cunning.
XMAS_SLY_DECOR_4: Using glowing lights to catch shoppers' eyes... A brilliant tactic. Sly makes note of these methods.
XMAS_SLY_ALL: Dirtmouth is overflowing with decorations, gifts, and lights... And from what I gather, that outsider charged a real fortune in Geo for every single one of them. Who in their right mind would squander their Geo pouch on trinkets you can't even fight with?... Why are you looking at me like that? Anyway, whoever that foolish naive bug was, they've ensured my shop has never seen so many customers. Long live the squandering!
XMAS_ISELDA_INTRO: An outsider dropped by the shop to buy a map of Hallownest. She said she just wanted to keep a memory of her journey before returning home... I asked where she was from, but she admitted her homeland lies far beyond any border Cornifer has ever mapped.
XMAS_ISELDA_DECOR_0: That garland on the door gives the shop a different feel. Perhaps I'll keep it for a while, even when the leaves go dry.
XMAS_ISELDA_DECOR_1: If anyone plans on leaving a present at the doorstep, I just hope it isn't more ink. Cornifer wastes enough of it on his own.
XMAS_ISELDA_DECOR_2: A small candle near the desk helps draw peacefully. My lines come out a bit straighter... though don't go thinking I'm getting overly excited about these things.
XMAS_ISELDA_DECOR_3: A large tree right in the middle of the square... It adds a curious touch to the surface landscape, though I'm not quite sure how to fit it onto a map.
XMAS_ISELDA_DECOR_4: Those tiny hanging lights brighten things up nicely at night. At least now travelers won't be tripping near the well.
XMAS_ISELDA_ALL: Dirtmouth looks different with all those lights burning... For the first time, the town doesn't feel so lonely on our maps. Even Cornifer stopped to admire them for a moment. I suppose a little sparkle does this old place no harm.
XMAS_TISO_INTRO: An outsider set up a trinket stall. I warned her that to trade here she ought to prove her worth with weapons... She merely smiled and offered me a strange sweet. I accepted it only to avoid wasting time arguing. A warrior must keep his energy up, nothing more.
XMAS_TISO_DECOR_0: Leaves hanging at the entrance? If that can't block a strike from my shield, I see no use for it.
XMAS_TISO_DECOR_1: Exchanging presents? If someone lays a legendary weapon at my feet, I'll take it. If it's just ornament and tin... I'll keep it so as not to seem ungracious.
XMAS_TISO_DECOR_2: They put candles everywhere. If someone tries a duel in the dark, they won't have any excuse for missing now.
XMAS_TISO_DECOR_3: A huge tree in the square. It would make a good target if I wanted to test the edge of my shield... But I suppose I'll leave it intact. Not today.
XMAS_TISO_DECOR_4: Little lights on the walls? I prefer the gleam of steel, but at least you can see where you're stepping.
XMAS_TISO_ALL: Don't go getting strange ideas... I only stood watching the lights because the surface air was far too chilly. They say these dates bring travelers together. Absurd. Though... I admit the stillness of this square feels different today.
XMAS_JIJI_INTRO: The outsider... exudes a peaceful presence, little one. She brings a calm that seems to soothe the air of this town. Even the Shades that left their sorrow here seem to rest easy near her stall.
XMAS_JIJI_DECOR_0: Green leaves on the doorways... A simple ornament, but it keeps the dampness away from the stone.
XMAS_JIJI_DECOR_1: A gift given in time can erase a small stain of regret, little one.
XMAS_JIJI_DECOR_2: The little candles ignite the gloom. My thoughts have been far more tranquil since they were lit.
XMAS_JIJI_DECOR_3: That great glowing tree dims the darkness of the square. A convenient focal point for souls seeking rest.
XMAS_JIJI_DECOR_4: Points of light in the gloom... They ensure no Shade loses its way back to the body.
XMAS_JIJI_ALL: Guilt-ridden Shades have settled beneath the great tree, watching the lights in silence. If you ever lose your shade in the depths, little one, remember that here on the surface there is light to guide it back.
XMAS_JINN_INTRO: Outsider. Jinn senses a different scent... Warm. Sweet. Not the stench of the kingdom nor the void. Jinn does not comprehend the utility of the object offered, but the warmth remains within shell.
XMAS_JINN_DECOR_0: Green branches. No trade value. Jinn prefers rotten wrappings or ancient relics.
XMAS_JINN_DECOR_1: Jinn requested gift: Rancid Egg. Outsider declined. Outsider offered empty shiny box. Jinn... confused.
XMAS_JINN_DECOR_2: Candles upon stone. Jinn counts flames. One. Two. Three. They do not feed the King. Only burn.
XMAS_JINN_DECOR_3: Large wooden structure with sparkles. Jinn finds no mechanism or gears. Useless object... yet eye-catching.
XMAS_JINN_DECOR_4: Luminous points in a row. Resemble eyes of watchers. Jinn evaluates... no danger detected.
XMAS_JINN_ALL: Jinn observed the large lit structure. The outsider uttered words: 'all are welcome'. Jinn lacks that category in record. Yet... Jinn remained before the light.
XMAS_BRUMM_INTRO: I saw the outsider light her lamps... No rituals, no dance of flames, without asking for anyone's devotion. A fire that exists only to warm the night. I, who have tended the Troupe's flame for so long... wonder what kind of fire does not consume the one who feeds it.
XMAS_BRUMM_DECOR_0: Adorning doors with greenery... A simple gesture. The Troupe knows only the red of flames and ash.
XMAS_BRUMM_DECOR_1: Giving a gift without demanding a ritual or a song of fire... I find it hard to comprehend, yet it feels gentle.
XMAS_BRUMM_DECOR_2: A humble wick... A quiet spark. The Troupe's flame demands passion and torment. This little light is content just keeping the cold company.
XMAS_BRUMM_DECOR_3: A great tree of wood and sparkles in the center... My accordion longs to play a gentle melody to accompany its branches.
XMAS_BRUMM_DECOR_4: Years holding the lantern for the Troupe... and never have I witnessed such a patient glow. It does not seek to devour, it only waits...
XMAS_BRUMM_ALL: I let a few notes drift from my accordion beneath the tree... The outsider listened in silence and offered a bow. Master would say only ritual fire holds true greatness. But in this forgotten town... this little light feels sweet.
XMAS_DIVINE_INTRO: Mmm-ahhh! A visitor with delicious aromas! She gave me a baked treat... So sweet! So crunchy! She says in her land they prepare entire feasts... Mmm, mmm! Divine wishes to taste that feast! I would pay thousands of Geo to devour that tradition!
XMAS_DIVINE_DECOR_0: Green branches hanging up? Mmm? Are they to be chewed? The outsider said no... What a waste of such a fresh scent...
XMAS_DIVINE_DECOR_1: Wrapped gifts! Ahhh! The outsider says they are unwrapped slowly... Divine wanted to swallow the whole box, but the contents were so fascinating!
XMAS_DIVINE_DECOR_2: Lit candles! Mmm! Warming up the air... Divine feels like chewing on the melted wax!
XMAS_DIVINE_DECOR_3: A gigantic tree steeped in resin... Mmm-hmmm... Divine cannot stop secreting juices just from smelling it...
XMAS_DIVINE_DECOR_4: Bright little lights! Mmm-ahhh! They look like sweets hanging on the walls... are you sure they're not for eating?
XMAS_DIVINE_ALL: A grand feast for everyone! Mmm-ahhh! Imagine the table brimming with delicacies... Even Troupe Master Grimm ought to try a slice. Divine never wants this 'Christmas' to end! It tastes far too good!
